source.title: Latin–English Booklet Missal for Praying the Traditional Mass
source.publisher: Coalition in Support of Ecclesia Dei
source.pageReference: 1-based PDF page = printed booklet page + 1 for Order of Mass

policy.latin: Controlling 1962 Missale Romanum. This English audit never changes Latin, rubrics, actions or Mass-form selection.
policy.english: Red Missal preferred English editorial baseline when the equivalent prayer is printed. Preserve legitimate translation variants pending review.
policy.french: Separately sourced French Ordinary; unchanged by English editorial decisions.
policy.provenance: User-supplied scan supports manual collation; record page, canonical cue, exact-before and after, and independent source where a Latin conflict is alleged. Do not commit entire scan or pretend OCR text is source-verified.

unresolvedTranslationDecisions.issue: Pater noster: current 'debts/debtors' is literal to Latin debita/debitoribus, booklet English uses 'trespasses'.
Kyrie: booklet 'have mercy on us'; current English 'have mercy'. Both grammatically complete, but booklet explicit object may be preferred for congregational prayer.
Gloria opening split in donor; active reader already composes correctly. Do not replace source with naive split Red text.
Frozen Latin donor has 'lucis pacis', but existing canonical overlay restores printed 'lucis et pacis'. No new fix.
Second Confiteor printed in 2013 booklet with explicit notice omitted in 1962 Missal; remain conditional optional local custom, never made normative.

reviewProtocol: Generate complete cue worklist from frozen canonical LOW and SUNG source, not OCR alone.
Show source Latin, current English, approved English and exact Red Missal page; verified English quotation must be visually checked against the scan.
Do not mark NOT_REVIEWED cues as identical to the booklet.
Promote exact-cue English replacements only after editorial approval; never alter priest/schola lane or Latin source.
Run complete Low/Sung and EN/FR actual reader projection tests and phonetic/liturgical source guards.
Copyright: preserve bibliographic reference; do not distribute the full uploaded scan or wholesale text extraction in app/repo without rights review.
